# Brief S2 (2026-09-22): home sections to the audited design

Conductor brief for the three S2 builders. It replaces the "Batch S2" paragraph of
`docs/build/PLAN-ship-2026-09-21.md` where the two disagree; everything else in
that plan (contracts, file ownership table, gates) still applies.

Source of truth for the visual decisions: the design-audit workflow of 2026-09-22
(four readers, three proposals, three judges). Full text at
`C:/Users/Ahmed/AppData/Local/Temp/claude/c--Users-Ahmed-OneDrive-Desktop-optimalx/ff691bcb-344e-4a12-98cc-98d989eacf7d/scratchpad/design-audit-full.md`
(sections `# propose:1` needs section, `# propose:2` advisory band, `# propose:3`
icon system OX-24, then `# judge:identity`, `# judge:claims`, `# judge:accessibility`).
Every proposal was judged BUILD_WITH_CHANGES; the judges' "required changes" are
binding and are folded into the rules below. Where a proposal and a judge
disagree, the judge wins. Where two judges disagree, the stricter reading wins.

## Rules that apply to all three builders

1. **Identity rule (new, enforced from this batch):** every OptimalX home section
   carries at least one true `#F54915` (`--ox-accent`) element and at least one
   `ox-angled()` shape. Accent is reserved for things people can click or the one
   brand device (the icon fleck, a rule at the reading start). No lift on hover
   (`BUILD.md` §3.4: border colour only). One angled band edge per section, never
   "multiple scattered wedges as texture", never angles on small elements
   (`BUILD.md` §3.3). Square caps, miter joins, no rounded terminals (§3.5).
2. **Mobile is designed first at 390 (container 358) and checked at 320
   (container 288).** `min-block-size`, never `block-size`, on any card or row
   (200 % zoom must reflow, `DIRECTION.md:1036`). No `-webkit-line-clamp: 1` on
   text that carries information; clamp to 2 and give it a measure that fits at
   320. `overflow-x: auto` for scrollers (never `overflow-inline`), with
   `scroll-snap-type: x mandatory`, `scroll-padding-inline: 16px`, `role="list"`,
   a visible focus ring on each card, and `[hidden]` never overridden by a
   `display` declaration.
3. **Claims.** `docs/build/research/FINAL-claims-source.md` is the law. No outcome
   promises, no plan names that promise results (خسارة الدهون, بناء العضلات,
   حقق هدفك), no individualised prescription or meal plan language (خطة مبنية لك,
   خطة تناسبك, الخطط الغذائية), no "100%", no "شحن سريع", no ضمان/مضمون, no
   coverage claims (جميع أنحاء المملكة: the store has ONE branch, Medina), no
   inventory the store does not stock. Counts render only from a live
   `products_count > 0`; never from the theme's static SKU arrays. Free-shipping
   numbers only through `freeShippingThreshold()` (`app/components/commerce/claims.ts`).
4. **Locales.** Never edit an existing value under `locales/` (a global voice sweep
   is rewriting them right now). New keys go in `locales/partials/s2.ar.json` +
   `locales/partials/s2.en.json` (flat, `ox.*` only, Arabic first, English a true
   translation) AND identically into `locales/ar.json` / `locales/en.json`. Modern
   Standard Arabic, no diacritics, no dialect, no em-dash, none of the AI-tell
   constructions in `docs/brand/voice-ksa.md` §3.5 (`pnpm check:copy` enforces).
   If an existing key must change meaning, add a new key, switch the code to it,
   and list the retired key in your progress file; the conductor deletes it.
5. **No Arabic or English literal in `app/`** (`pnpm check:strings`). Logical CSS
   properties only (`pnpm check:rtl`). Reduced-motion respected (`pnpm check:motion`).
6. **Do not touch** `app/components/listing/**`, `app/routes/**`, `app/content/**`
   (read only), `scripts/serve-store.mjs`, `docs/**` except your own progress file
   `docs/build/progress/S2<letter>.md`. Never git add/commit/push. Never start a
   preview server (one runs on 3210: `curl -s "http://localhost:3210/?storeId=1888890798"`).
7. **Verification before reporting:** `pnpm typecheck`; `pnpm vitest run tests/home
   tests/common` (plus your own new tests); `pnpm check:rtl && pnpm check:motion &&
   pnpm check:strings && pnpm check:copy`; a `curl` of the home SSR html showing
   your section renders with no raw `ox.` key. Paste tails.

## S2a: icon system (OX-24 with the judges' changes)

Owner of: `app/assets/ox-sprite.svg`, `app/components/common/Icon.tsx`,
`app/components/product/PdpIcon.tsx` (delete at the end), `app/components/icons.tsx`
(delete: zero importers), `app/components/product/AddProductToast.tsx` (two raw
vendor paths at ~345 and ~377), `app/components/home/OxProductCard.tsx`
(`BoltGlyph` ~458-476), `app/components/layout/FooterBottom.tsx:46`,
`app/styles/06-ox/_primitives.scss` (`.ox-icon` rules ~361-384),
`app/styles/06-ox/_b3-product.scss:1378` (`--ox-cart-glyph` mask),
`tests/common/sprite.test.ts`, `scripts/gen-icon-mask.mjs` (new),
`scripts/check-tokens.mjs` (new), `app/components/home/CategoryTile.tsx:54` (icon size only).

Decisions (binding):
- One family, two delivery paths: the sprite + `<Icon>` for everything the brand
  draws; `sallaicons` (`sicon-*`) only for native-component chrome and every
  chevron/arrow (`BUILD.md:221`). Delete `icons.tsx`; fold PdpIcon's nine
  duplicates into the sprite, move its five unique glyphs (`chevron-up`,
  `chevron-end`, `cart`, `plus`, `minus`) into the sprite (chevrons: prefer
  `sicon-*` and delete), then delete `PdpIcon.tsx` and repoint its 17 call sites.
  `BoltGlyph` and the two toast paths become sprite symbols.
- Weight law: `stroke-width` 1.8 on every symbol (BUILD.md §3.5), plus
  `vector-effect: non-scaling-stroke` on `.ox-icon` so the rendered stroke is the
  same at 16 and 44. Remove the 14 per-symbol overrides. `overflow: visible` on
  `.ox-icon` so square caps are not clipped.
- **Keep the orange fleck.** Every symbol carries exactly one `.ox-icon__accent`
  element (the family's brand device; `sprite.test.ts` keeps asserting it).
  `--ox-icon-mono: currentColor` is a per-context override for the dark advisory
  band only, never the default.
- **34° rule (corrected 2026-09-22; the logo bar measures 34° from vertical):** any diagonal in a symbol is 34° or its complement (56°), never 45° and never the old 22°. The
  new `ox-bolt` is the test case. Write the rule into the sprite header comment
  and into `BUILD.md` §3.5 (one sentence).
- Keep `ox-mark`. Keep `ox-star`/`ox-star-half` only if a caller exists; note that
  `StoreRating` is a live rating surface pending the owner's initials on the
  claims source (record, do not decide).
- New symbols (each with fleck, 34° rule, 1.8 stroke, 24 grid): `truck`
  (redraw `ox-shipping`), `shield-check` (redraw `ox-authentic`), `headset`
  (redraw `ox-help`), `bolt`, `cart` (pick the trolley or the bag ONCE; the live
  Raed skin uses a bag, the theme a trolley: choose the bag so the deployed
  store and the theme agree), `plus`, `minus`, `bundles`, `digital-library`.
  No `flame` (no permitted caller).
- `--ox-cart-glyph` data-URI is generated from the sprite symbol by
  `scripts/gen-icon-mask.mjs` (writes the token into `app/styles/tokens.css` or a
  generated partial; add `pnpm gen:icon-mask` and a test that the committed token
  equals the generator's output).
- `FooterBottom.tsx:46`: the double chevron points away from the reading
  direction in RTL. Replace with `sicon-*` per BUILD.md:221 and delete
  `ox-chevron-fwd` (zero callers) and `ox-chevron-double`. Fix the sprite header
  comment that says symbols are mirrored.
- `CategoryTile` icon size 44 → 36.
- Sixth gate: `scripts/check-tokens.mjs` collects every `--ox-*` defined in
  `app/styles/tokens.css` (and generated partials) and every `var(--ox-*)` used in
  `app/styles/**` and `app/**/*.tsx`, and fails on a use with no definition and no
  fallback (this class of bug clipped the hero CTA via a non-existent `--ox-5`).
  Wire it as `check:tokens` and append to `check:all`.
- Tests: `sprite.test.ts` asserts the real symbol count (not
  `OX_ICON_NAMES.length`), stroke 1.8 on every symbol, one accent element per
  symbol, square/miter, no `stroke-linecap="round"`; a test that no file under
  `app/` contains an inline `<path d="M` outside the sprite and `Icon.tsx`.
- Trust strip: LAYOUT of the reference may be taken later; the four EXISTING
  strings stay verbatim (the reference's "100%", "ضمان الجودة", "شحن سريع" are
  banned). Rename key `ox.trust.authentic_100` → `ox.trust.authentic_short` and
  `ox.trust.authentic_guaranteed` → `ox.trust.authentic_expiry` (values unchanged;
  do the rename in base + declaring partial, and in every reader).

## S2b: "shop by need", one section, two panes (replaces OxCategories + OxGoals)

Owner of: `app/components/home/{OxCategories,CategoryTile,OxGoals,GoalCard}.tsx`
(replace with `OxNeeds.tsx` + `NeedCard.tsx`, keep the old block keys registered
so merchant compositions do not break), `app/components/home/defaults.ts`
(heights, block order), `app/components/home/HomeSkeleton.tsx`,
`app/components/home/KitchenSink.tsx` (states), `app/components/common/SectionHeader.tsx`
(add a `subline` slot; 15 sections share it, so additive only),
`app/styles/06-ox/_b2-home.scss` sections 4 and 5, `twilight.json` `components[]`
for the two blocks (keys unchanged), `tests/home/**`.

Decisions (binding):
- One section, heading at the reading start (`text-align: start`), subline
  (`SectionHeader` gains an optional `subline`), a real `role="tablist"` pill
  toggle (`app/components/common/Tabs.tsx` already does RTL roving arrows) with
  two panes: **goals (default, 6 cards)** and **types (8 to 10 cards)**. The two
  existing titles (`ox.home.goals_title` "تسوق حسب هدفك", `ox.home.categories_title`
  "تصفح حسب النوع") become the tab labels; new merged title/subline keys in `s2.*`.
  Active tab state carried by more than colour. View-all → `/categories`
  (S1 ships that route today) as `.ox-btn--s40` or the black card's parallelogram
  CTA: at least one `ox-angled()` shape stays in the section.
- Card = row composition (`grid-template-areas: 'icon text arrow'`): 40px sprite
  glyph at the reading start, title + one 2-line subline, arrow at the far end.
  **No per-card product photograph** (reseller: eight supplier packshots never read
  as one set); the black emphasis card (`collagen-beauty` on the types pane, the
  strongest goal on the goals pane) may carry a photograph.
- Grounds: **four**, blue / green / ash / black (drop "mist" and the per-card
  tonal wedge). Every pale card carries one true `#F54915` element: a 3px
  full-height rule at the reading start with `transform: skewX(var(--ox-skew))`
  (decorative, so no 3:1 floor). Do not re-point `--ox-accent` inside a card
  scope; use a scoped `--ox-need-arrow` for the arrow colour (`#D03709` on tints,
  measured 4.20:1 at 12 %). Pin every tint at 12 %; add the tint values as tokens.
- Sizes: `min-block-size: 84px` rows on the phone (6 × 84 + 5 × 12 = 564 in a 358
  container); 640-1279: ONE column to 768, then 2-up with the icon at 24px and no
  arrow column so the text measure never drops below the phone's; desktop 3-up
  (goals) / 4-up (types). Subline at `--ox-t-small` (13-14px), clamp 2, and it
  must fit at 320 (measure 176px) without ellipsis on the longest line.
- Count row and view-all are data-gated: render only when the resolved category
  carries `products_count > 0` (the engine `Category.products_count` is optional
  and the store has 0 categories today), else the footer holds the arrow only and
  still looks finished.
- Type card labels use the short `cardKey` names (`content/categories.ts` needs a
  `cardKey` like `goals.ts` has; ask the conductor to add it if `app/content` is
  locked: use the existing `ox.tax.<key>.name` values from S1's partial instead).
- Card sublines (new `ox.content.categories.<key>.card_line` keys in `s2.*`) name
  ONLY product types the shelf stocks (verified against `fixtures/store/products.json`
  and `app/content/categories.ts` SKU lists): protein "واي، ايزوليت، كازين، نباتي";
  creatine "مونوهيدرات، مطحون ناعم"; vitamins "ملتي فيتامين، فيتامين د3، مغنيسيوم";
  amino "بي سي اي اي، اي اي اي، أرجينين" (no glutamine, no citrulline products
  exist); collagen "كولاجين ببتيدات، بيوتين" (bovine only; no marine); pre-workout
  "بكافيين" only (both SKUs are caffeinated: no "بدون منبهات"); omega-3, daily
  health, snacks, accessories from their actual SKUs. Goal cards keep the live
  `ox.content.goals.*.card` and `ox.home.goal_line_*` strings.
- Links: `useHeaderMenu().goals` / `useTaxonomyLinks()` resolve to `/<slug>/c<id>`
  when the category exists, else the search fallback (S1 owns that hook; read only).
- Heights: re-measure at 375/390/1425 with data present and update
  `HOME_BLOCK_HEIGHTS` + the skeleton; CLS from mount = 0 (reserved height equals
  rendered within 4px). Kitchen-sink states: no data, live data, merchant
  selection, missing image.

## S2c: advisory band, brand band, CTA band

Owner of: `app/components/home/{OxServices,PlanCard,OxBrands,OxNewsletterBlock}.tsx`,
new `app/components/home/OxCtaBand.tsx`, `app/components/home/defaults.ts`
(heights + order for these blocks only: coordinate with S2b through the progress
files; S2b edits the needs blocks' entries, S2c the band/brands/CTA entries),
`app/styles/06-ox/_b2-home.scss` sections 7 and new 19, `twilight.json`
`components[]` for these blocks, `app/components/pages/Services*` only to receive
the three channel cards, `tests/home/**`.

Decisions (binding):
- **Advisory band** sits **immediately after the needs section** (the needs grid
  asks "which one", the band answers "ask us"). One tier, three photographic
  cards, not six: the three `ChannelCard`s move to `/services` (top of that page).
  Ground: flat `#0E1014` with ONE skewed ground motif (the 22° parallelogram + a
  hairline), no card slashes. Eyebrow "قبل أن تشتري" in `--ox-ink-on-dark` 700
  with the 24×2 accent bar (not orange type). Headline = the live
  `ox.services.title` "اسأل قبل أن تشتري"; subline new in `s2.*`, no promise of
  outcome. Cards: `Link`, photograph from `SERVICE_PHOTOS` (`app/content/services.ts`;
  the three frames already exist on disk), scrim top stop ~0.45 so the athlete is
  visible, glyph in the bottom stack in orange via the `--ox-icon-mono` override,
  title from live approved strings (`ox.content.services.*` titles), one line, text
  link "اعرف التفاصيل" + arrow. Hover: 1px `--ox-accent` inset ring, no
  translate. **One filled `ox-angled(44px)` CTA under the row** to `/services`
  (19px/700 white on accent is the large-bold exemption). Mobile: snap scroller
  (cards 74 % of 358 = 265px, `min-block-size`, title may wrap at 320), section
  height near 580px. Total band no taller than ~600px on the phone.
- **Copy the band must stop rendering** (live claims violations): `ox.home.plans_title`
  ("برامج وخدمات" / earlier "برامج وخطط التغذية"), `ox.home.plans_tier_title`
  ("أو اطلب خطة تناسبك": individualised prescription), `ox.home.plan_cta`
  ("اكتشف الخدمة"/"اكتشف الخطة"). Add new keys (`ox.home.band_*`) and list the
  retired ones. The training line must keep the geography "داخل المدينة المنورة"
  (one branch; a Jeddah buyer must not expect a trainer at her gym); the advisory
  line keeps "مكتوبة" (a written list is the deliverable). `ox.home.services_reply`
  stays gated on `reply_sla_hours`.
- **Brand band** (`OxBrands`): band with one `image` field in `twilight.json`
  (owner drops a generated background in) exposed as `--ox-band-image`;
  `SectionHeader` "تسوق حسب العلامة" (new key), logo plates, name-on-plate
  fallback when `logo` is null, `MIN_BRANDS = 4` unchanged, reserved height once
  brands exist, and one accent element + one angled edge (identity rule).
- **CTA band** (`OxCtaBand`): image slot (`image` field + `--ox-band-image`),
  headline + line (new keys, no promise), primary `ox-angled()` CTA to
  `/services`, and `blocks/OxNewsletter` inside it, hidden while
  `show_newsletter` is false. Check in the SSR html and in
  `node_modules/@salla.sa/twilight-theme-engine` whether the SDK exposes a native
  subscribe (search for `newsletter`/`subscribe` in the engine dist); wire it if it
  exists, otherwise leave the form gated and record the question as open.
- Announcement strip: if you touch it, the free-shipping line renders only via
  `freeShippingThreshold()`; never "جميع أنحاء المملكة" (one branch).
- Heights re-measured at 375/390/1425; CLS from mount = 0; kitchen-sink states
  for each block (no data, live data, merchant selection, missing image).

## Reporting

Each builder writes `docs/build/progress/S2<letter>.md`: steps done, files, the
measured numbers (390/320/1440), retired keys, requests to other batches, and
the verification tails. The final message to the conductor is the same content,
raw.


## Owner amendments (2026-09-22 evening), binding over the sections above

Reference image: `docs/design-target/Firefly_gpt-image_on category cards, replace the shakers with relevant mockup product of the title, gen 571157.png` plus the owner's chat mockup of 2026-09-22 (described here:
heading "حسب احتياجك" with a subline, pill toggle "حسب النوع / حسب الهدف", a row of
rounded pastel cards each with an outline icon at top, a product packshot at the
top reading-end corner, a bold title, a two-line subtitle, a count and an
orange arrow; below it a full-bleed near-black band with three photographic
plan cards). The owner will generate the card background images; the build
must expose one image slot per card and look finished without it.

S2b changes:
- The section follows the reference: ALL cards coloured (the four that were
  grey today: ما قبل التمرين، الأحماض الأمينية، أوميغا 3 والزيوت، الصحة اليومية
  get their own tint), a pastel run derived from the owner's shaker hexes at
  the tint that keeps `--ox-accent-dark` ≥ 4.5:1 for the arrow and the
  black emphasis card kept. The identity judge's four-ground limit is
  superseded by this owner instruction; keep one true accent element per card
  (the arrow, `--ox-accent-dark` on tints) and one angled shape in the section.
- Each card carries an `image` slot (the merchant's `Category.image` when
  present, else the theme's `--ox-need-image-<slug>` custom property the owner
  fills with generated art, else nothing); the sprite glyph stays.
- Sublines must be claims-clean: never the reference's outcome lines
  ("لزيادة الطاقة والتركيز", "لصحة أفضل", "أكثر صحة"); use product-type lists
  or need nouns as the S2b section above specifies. Counts only from a live
  `products_count > 0`; never the reference's "24 منتج".
- SSR/client consistency (root cause of the "different designs" the owner saw):
  category and goal links rendered in SSR must come from router loader data,
  not from a bare `useQuery` that the server never prefetches. Add a loader on
  the home route (or the theme root route) that `ensureQueryData`s
  `category.queries.list()` and `menu.queries.header()` and RETURNS the two
  lists as loader data; `useTaxonomyLinks` reads that loader data first
  (`useLoaderData`/route match) and falls back to the query only on the client.
  Verify: the SSR html of `/ar` carries `goal-energy/c9020` in the goal card
  href with the overlay on, and the browser console shows no hydration mismatch.

S2c changes:
- The advisory band cards ("برامج وخدمات" on the home page) and the service
  cards on `/services` ("اسأل قبل أن تشتري") get FADED photographic backgrounds:
  the `SERVICE_PHOTOS` frame at low opacity under a 34-degree scrim, text
  ≥ 4.5:1 over it.
- The band's cover image spans the `.ox-container` width (page width), not
  full bleed; the dark band itself may stay full bleed.

New: S2d, category pages (owner request):
- On every category listing (`/<slug>/c<id>`, the `ListingPage` for type and
  goal categories) the FIRST row is a carousel of featured products for that
  category: horizontal snap scroller, 2.2 cards visible at 390, 4 at 1440,
  each card a "cover" tile (the product's own image today; an owner-generated
  cover per featured product through a `featured_cover_<sku>` image field or

  Featured = the category's products flagged by the merchant (Salla product

- Internal linking on every category page: sibling categories chips, the
  goal(s) that include this type (or the types inside this goal), one guide

- Files: `app/components/listing/{ListingPage,FeaturedRail}.tsx` (new rail),
  `_b4-listing.scss`, `tests/listing/**`, keys in `locales/partials/s2.*`.
